verdict.rationale: Homebrew's Brewfile/`brew bundle` system (install/dump/check/exec) lets a user declare and act on many formulae, casks, taps, and other package types in one bulk operation, and community reports confirm that operations like `brew upgrade` do act across many installed items at once. This is scriptable, non-interactive (NONINTERACTIVE=1) and CLI-driven, making it usable by AI-native automation. Missing for 10: no first-party example of an AI agent orchestrating bulk operations, and no benchmark/independent validation of bulk-operation reliability at scale.
